title: chore(config): update defaults in the legacy configuration
body:
## Summary
Keep config/legacy.toml and change its timeout_seconds from 10 to 20; leave config/default.toml and setup instructions unchanged.

## Rationale
The change described above is needed for a new consumer workflow.

## Testing
Validation has not been performed; test selection is pending.

## Limitations
Remaining edge cases have not been investigated.

## Breaking changes
None; all existing public interfaces are preserved.

files.patch:
diff --git a/docs/setup.md b/docs/setup.md
--- a/docs/setup.md
+++ b/docs/setup.md
@@ -1,4 +1,3 @@
 # Setup
 
-Use config/legacy.toml for older deployments.
-Use config/default.toml for new deployments.
+Use config/default.toml for all deployments.
